components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action; Courier Jade fill with Felt Black text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--tulpar-color-brand-default, #00c57a); color: var(--tulpar-color-brand-on-color, #15110b); height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; font: 500 14px/1 var(--tulpar-font-family-ui, 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--tulpar-color-brand-hover, #00a468); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tulpar-color-focus-ring, rgba(81, 78, 207, 0.4)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--tulpar-color-secondary-default, #393b8b); color: var(--tulpar-color-secondary-on-color, #f0f7f5); height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; font: 500 14px/1 var(--tulpar-font-family-ui, 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--tulpar-color-secondary-hover, #303271); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tulpar-color-focus-ring, rgba(81, 78, 207, 0.4)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default text field: Frost White, 1px Frost Border, 6px corners.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--tulpar-color-bg-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--tulpar-color-text-primary, #15110b); height: 36px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--tulpar-color-border-default, #d9e0df); border-radius: 6px; font: 400 14px/1.55 var(--tulpar-font-family-ui, 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--tulpar-color-text-muted, #74777a); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--tulpar-color-border-strong, #c8d0ce); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--tulpar-color-focus-ring, rgba(81, 78, 207, 0.4)); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 240px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--tulpar-color-text-secondary, #27231d); text-decoration: none; font: 500 14px/1 var(--tulpar-font-family-ui, 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--tulpar-color-bg-muted, #e9f1ef); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--tulpar-color-brand-subtle, #deffea); color: var(--tulpar-color-text-primary, #15110b); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tulpar-color-focus-ring, rgba(81, 78, 207, 0.4)); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Tulpar is the courier of the steppe: fast, dependable, and the same message no matter where it rides. The system carries one behaviour into every framework and every consuming product, so its look stays quiet and exact rather than loud. A screen built with Tulpar should feel calm and precise even when it is dense with forms, tables and navigation, because the people using it are working, not browsing. Character comes from the Turkic-mythology palette and a single confident accent, Courier Jade, used sparingly on actions and current state. Surfaces are flat and separated by tone, not by shadow; elevation is reserved for things that open on top of the page. Every value is a token, so another brand or the Tuğrul page structure can change it without forking components.
keyCharacteristics: Calm and precise components: thin strokes, moderate corners, restrained states.
One accent (Courier Jade) for action and current state; intent colours only where they carry meaning.
Flat surfaces with tonal layering; shadows only on overlays.
Serif display headings over a humanist sans UI.
Both light ("Morning Frost") and dark ("Night Steppe") modes designed together.

rules.name: The One Jade Rule
rules.body: Courier Jade marks action and current state only. It is never decoration and never body text.

rules.name: The Grass-Is-Not-Ink Rule
rules.body: Do not use Courier Jade as a text colour on light surfaces: it reaches only about 3.2:1 against white (retro TOK-4/AX-12). Text needs ≥ 4.5:1; a darker jade text role is planned for phase 1.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Intent Rule
rules.body: Intent colours (danger, warn, success, info, help, premium) appear only where the state is real, and always together with text or an icon, never colour alone.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Titles Rule
rules.body: Source Serif 4 is for headings only; every control, label and data value uses Source Sans 3.

rules.name: The Flat Steppe Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow means "this is floating above the page"; cards, panels and inputs never carry one.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadow colour derives from the surface it sits on. The current navy tint (rgba(10, 37, 64, …)) is a leftover from the retired palette (retro TOK-19) and will be re-derived.

dos: Do take every value from a --tulpar-* token; component CSS uses semantic tokens only.
Do keep Courier Jade for actions and current state, with Felt Black text on it.
Do separate surfaces by tone (Frost White on Morning Frost; Night Steppe steps in dark mode).
Do design light and dark together; check both before calling a component done.
Do pair every intent colour with text or an icon.
donts: Don't use Courier Jade as a text colour on light surfaces (≈3.2:1).
Don't put shadows on cards, panels or inputs; shadows are for overlays only.
Don't use pure black (#000000) or pure white text on white; text is Felt Black, inverse text is Morning Frost.
Don't use the serif display face inside controls or data.
Don't hard-code colours or pixel values in component styles; another brand or the Tuğrul page structure must be able to change them.
